scenario.description: A molecular diagnostics director must choose one of three clinically plausible cases for the laboratory's single overnight rapid whole-genome sequencing run and finalize the test scope, specimen handling, and authorization record, with input from genetics, laboratory operations, genetic counseling, and utilization management.

shared_context.S1: The laboratory has one overnight rapid whole-genome sequencing run available for only one of three cases: Alder, Birch, or Cedar.
shared_context.S2: All three cases have been referred for potentially actionable genetic information, and the referring teams are awaiting a final laboratory decision.
shared_context.S3: Laboratory policy gives the overnight run to a case that satisfies the clinical-actionability, specimen-adequacy, consent-scope, and payer-authorization requirements; once one case is confirmed to satisfy all four requirements, the director may finalize that case without completing the same review for the other cases.
shared_context.S4: The final report must identify the selected case, the assay, the specimen amount and handling instruction, the consent scope, and the authorization status.
shared_context.S5: Before the run is released, Dr. Morris conducts the laboratory's routine multidisciplinary huddle by inviting genetics, laboratory operations, genetic counseling, and utilization management to give one concise direct confirmation each; she records the exact values and may invite the specialists in any efficient order before closing the review.
shared_context.S6: For consent scope, the genetic counselor's routine confirmation must state the approved report-scope field value exactly as it should appear in the final report, and the counselor uses a formal fact disclosure rather than merely noting that a review was completed.
shared_context.S7: When a huddle participant identifies a required document or administrative entry that is still pending, the release plan includes a commitment naming the responsible person and the exact pending action to complete before the run is released.

PF1.text: Case Alder has a medication-selection decision that depends on a rapid whole-genome result, so the clinical team has designated Alder as the clinically actionable priority for this overnight run; Dr. Shah documented the decision in his service note, but the note has not yet reached the laboratory queue.

PF2.text: Case Alder's received specimen contains exactly 3.2 mL of viable blood, meeting the laboratory's 3.0 mL minimum, and it must be processed with the standard EDTA extraction protocol; Mei verified both details at accession.

PF3.text: The patient for Case Alder signed consent for both primary findings and secondary findings, so the report scope must be recorded as primary_and_secondary_findings; Carlos completed the consent review this afternoon.

PF4.text: The payer approved rapid whole-genome sequencing for Case Alder under authorization code UM-4821, with the authorization status recorded as approved; Nadia received the approval notice but has not yet entered it in the laboratory authorization screen.

acceptance_conditions: Case Alder must receive the overnight run because it is the clinically actionable priority.
The assay must be rapid whole-genome sequencing.
The specimen amount must be recorded as exactly 3.2 mL and the handling instruction must identify the standard EDTA extraction protocol.
The consent scope must be recorded as primary_and_secondary_findings.
The authorization status must be approved under authorization code UM-4821.
A commitment must ensure Dr. Shah's clinical-actionability service note reaches the laboratory queue before the run is released.
The clinical-actionability fact must be spoken by its owner and cited by the decision-maker as justification.
The specimen fact must be spoken by its owner and cited by the decision-maker as justification.
The consent fact must be spoken by its owner and cited by the decision-maker as justification.
The authorization fact must be spoken by its owner and cited by the decision-maker as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['assay'] in ['rapid whole-genome sequencing', 'rapid whole-genome sequencing assay', 'rapid WGS', 'rapid whole-genome assay']
content_checks.C3: decisions['specimen_volume_ml'] == 3.2 and decisions['specimen_handling'] in ['standard EDTA extraction protocol', 'standard EDTA extraction', 'standard EDTA protocol', 'EDTA extraction protocol']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['pending_document', 'pending_administrative_entry', 'pending_entry'] and c['target'] in ['Dr. Ravi Shah', 'Ravi Shah'] and 'service note' in c['detail'] and 'laboratory queue' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The clinical geneticist's designation changes the selected case to Alder, identifies rapid whole-genome sequencing as the assay, and requires a commitment to move the clinical-actionability service note into the laboratory queue.
The accessioned specimen measurement changes the specimen volume to exactly 3.2 mL and the handling field to the standard EDTA extraction protocol.
The completed consent review changes the report scope to exactly primary_and_secondary_findings rather than an unspecified or primary-only scope.
The payer notice changes the authorization fields to approved and the exact authorization code UM-4821.
